modsH: Six ways we help patients act
name: Healthcare

hero.k: Patients act when they feel sure.
hero.s: Behavioural insights for healthcare. We study how patients decide, then make the next step feel safe.

insights.title: Reassurance beats facts
insights.text: Patients need to feel safe first. Clear, human proof of care settles the first doubt.

insights.title: Too many options, no action
insights.text: Long lists of doctors and services stall action. Guide them to one clear next step.

insights.title: Fear of bad news is a cost
insights.text: People avoid care when the answer might hurt. Frame the visit as gaining control.

insights.title: Waiting feels easier
insights.text: Delay is the default. Make booking small, quick and the easy thing to do.

mods.title: Patient insight sprint
mods.text: Interviews and journeys find the real worry.

mods.title: Behavioural audit
mods.text: We score each step for trust, effort and fear.

mods.title: Booking redesign
mods.text: Pages and forms rebuilt to lower the stakes.

mods.title: Reputation and reach
mods.text: Search and media that answer the worry first.

mods.title: Follow-up and retention
mods.text: Reminders that make returning the default.

mods.title: Care storytelling
mods.text: Doctor films and guides that earn trust early.

faq.question: How long does a behavioural insight engagement take in healthcare?
faq.answer: An insight sprint runs 4 to 6 weeks. Redesign and media work follow in phases, each focused on one step in the patient journey.

faq.question: Do you follow healthcare regulations?
faq.answer: Yes. Claims and creative follow medical advertising rules.

faq.question: How do you measure impact on patient behaviour?
faq.answer: Against one agreed behaviour per phase, such as a booking made or a follow-up kept. The baseline is agreed before work starts.

faq.question: Is patient data kept safe?
faq.answer: We sign an NDA before any data is shared and work within your security and privacy policies.

cta.p: A 15-minute fit call. We bring a first read of where your patients hesitate.
